name: Shortcut
description: Shortcut is a project management platform built for software development teams to plan, track, and ship work with fast, keyboard-driven workflows.
best_for: Engineering and product teams that need issue tracking tightly integrated with their code, without heavyweight configuration.
features: Sprints and iterations for time-boxed planning
Roadmaps and objectives to align work with company goals
Docs for linking plans to execution
VCS automations syncing with GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed yearly (save up to 25% vs. monthly). Best for small teams.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Per user/month, billed yearly (save up to 25% vs. monthly). Best for fast-growing teams.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing. For mature software companies. Contact sales.
